title: SQL injection via unsanitized user input
rationale: User input is concatenated directly into the SQL query without parameterization.

title: Off-by-one error in range calculation
rationale: The range ends at len(items) - 1 but should end at len(items) to include the last element.

title: Magic number without named constant
rationale: The value 3600 (seconds in an hour) should be extracted to a named constant for clarity.

title: Redundant O(n^2) nested loop when O(n) possible
rationale: The nested loop iterates over the same list twice; a set-based lookup would be O(n).

title: Function exceeds 80 lines — refactor candidate
rationale: The function handle_request is 110 lines and handles too many concerns; split into smaller units.
